questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides to Dr. Sofia: 'I'm tired, I have back pain, my hands sometimes tremble.' Dr. Sofia asks him if he has seen a doctor. Dr. Ahmed replies: 'No, I don't have time.' Dr. Sofia explains that the first thing to do is to:
options: Consult a doctor for a check-up
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, the first thing to do is to consult a doctor. A complete health check-up will allow you to identify problems and treat them. Your health is your most precious asset.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks Dr. Sofia: 'How can I reduce my fatigue without losing patients?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Adjust your schedule and plan breaks
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, adjust your schedule. Start later, plan breaks, and delegate some tasks to your assistant. Fatigue is a warning signal that should not be ignored.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I can't concentrate at the end of the day.' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Reduce patients at the end of the day
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, concentration naturally decreases with age. Reduce the number of patients at the end of the day and plan breaks to recharge your batteries.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to manage back pain related to my profession?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Consult an ergonomist to adapt his workstation
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, ergonomics are essential. Consult an ergonomist to adapt your chair, your position, and your instruments. Prevention is better than cure.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders: 'Should I stop completely?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: No, you can continue by adapting your activity
He must work more to catch up
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, you don't have to stop completely. You can continue by reducing your working time, specializing, or going part-time.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks Dr. Sofia: 'How to talk about my fatigue to my patients?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, transparency is key. Explain to your patients that you are reducing your working time to better treat them. They will understand and respect your choice.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I don't feel as competent as before.' Dr. Sofia replies that:
options: Experience compensates for the decrease in speed
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, your experience is invaluable. You have seen thousands of cases, you have developed a clinical wisdom that the young do not have. You are more competent than you think.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks Dr. Sofia: 'How to prepare my succession?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Identify a buyer and prepare the transition
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, succession is prepared gradually. Identify a young colleague who shares your values, train them, and plan a transition over several years.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders about the future of his patient base. Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Leave his patients without a solution
Introduce his successor to his patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, introduce your successor to your patients. Explain to them that you have chosen a trusted person to take over the practice. Patient loyalty is linked to the trust they have in you.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks Dr. Sofia: 'How to manage the stress of transmission?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, transmission is a complex step. Surround yourself with professionals who will accompany you in the legal, tax, and human aspects.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I no longer have the same energy as before.' Dr. Sofia suggests he:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, physical activity is essential to maintain your energy and health. A 30-minute walk a day can make a big difference.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to maintain my motivation?' Dr. Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, set yourself new goals. Maybe you want to train a young colleague, specialize further, or share your experience through teaching.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders about his pension rights. Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Consult the CNSS to know his rights
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, consult the CNSS to know your pension rights. You have contributed all your life, you are entitled to a dignified retirement.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to reduce my workload?' Dr. Sofia suggests he:
options: Reduce the number of patients per day
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, reducing the number of patients per day is a simple and effective solution. Fewer patients, less fatigue, more quality.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'My young colleagues are faster than me.' Dr. Sofia replies that:
options: Speed is not always an asset
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, speed is not always an asset. Quality, precision, and experience are what your patients look for in you.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to prepare for retirement?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Plan his retirement over several years
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, retirement is prepared over several years. Plan your activities, your projects, and the transition. A successful retirement is a prepared retirement.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders about teaching. Dr. Sofia suggests he:
options: Become a professor at the faculty
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, training young dentists is a beautiful way to pass on your experience. You can become a mentor or tutor.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to manage the relationship with elderly patients?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Adapt his communication to their age
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, elderly patients have specific needs. Communicate with them with patience, respect, and empathy.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I no longer have any professional projects.' Dr. Sofia suggests he:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, projects give meaning to professional life. Maybe you want to create a network of senior dentists, or share your experience.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to manage the decrease in income during retirement?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, financial planning is essential. Consult a financial advisor to prepare your retirement with peace of mind.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders about mentoring young people. Dr. Sofia suggests he:
options: Leave them to figure it out
Become a mentor and share his experience
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, becoming a mentor is a beautiful way to pass on your experience and stay active in the profession.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to manage the fear of the unknown?' Dr. Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, the fear of the unknown is normal. Anticipate, prepare, surround yourself with trusted people, and the fear will fade.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I don't want to lose my professional identity.' Dr. Sofia replies that:
options: His identity is not limited to his practice
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, your professional identity is rich. You are a dentist, a mentor, a trainer, a colleague. It is not limited to your practice.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to maintain ties with my colleagues after retirement?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, joining professional associations will allow you to keep ties and stay informed of developments in the profession.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders about the value of his practice. Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Estimate the value of his practice with an expert
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Ahmed, a professional valuation of your practice is essential for a successful sale or transfer.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed, at the end of their conversation, says: 'Sofia, I feel less alone and more serene.' Dr. Sofia replies that the transition to retirement is a transition. Ahmed concludes:
options: Retirement is an end in itself
Retirement is a new stage of life
Retirement is a waste of time
questions.explanation: Ahmed: 'Sofia, thank you for all this advice. I feel ready to face my future with serenity.' Sofia: 'Ahmed, retirement is a new stage of life, rich with possibilities. Prepare it, live it fully, and don't forget to take care of yourself.'
